{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute conversion rate by channel and customer_segment
# We need to compute conversion rate within each customer_segment to avoid confounding
conversion_rates = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Calculate the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) within each segment
# We will compute the overall difference as a weighted average across segments
# First, get total counts per segment
total_per_segment = df_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Compute segment-specific differences
diff_by_segment = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Weight by segment size to get overall effect
weighted_diff = (diff_by_segment * total_per_segment).sum() / total_per_segment.sum()

# Print results
print(f"Conversion rates by channel and segment:\n{conversion_rates}")
print(f"Segment-level differences (email - paid_search):\n{diff_by_segment}")
print(f"Weighted average difference (overall effect): {weighted_diff:.4f}")

# Also compute raw difference for comparison
raw_email_rate = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
raw_paid_rate = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
raw_diff = raw_email_rate - raw_paid_rate
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff:.4f}")"}
